title: A forradalom kitörése (Október 23.) (The Outbreak of the Revolution)
grammar: Directives of Freedom, Asymmetric Warfare & Sovereign Historical Discourse

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what happened in Budapest on 23 October 1956 and what the students demanded.
I can say what the sixteen points were.
I can say what the crowd did to the Stalin statue and what happened at the Radio.
I can use six words about the outbreak, such as tizenhat pont and lyukas zászló.
